// GREEN fixture for `no-cross-db` — the lint MUST admit this.
// Depending on a sibling service's CONTRACT surface (its public types, traits, ids) is allowed;
// it is the frozen glue-crate coupling, not a reach into the data layer.
use myelin_identity::PrincipalId;
use myelin_identity::CheckRequest;

pub fn build_request(id: PrincipalId) -> CheckRequest {
    CheckRequest::for_principal(id)
}
